seo_title: Programs | Net Impact IU Project Teams and Workshops
seo_description: Net Impact IU programs: semester-long nonprofit consulting project teams, weekly professional development meetings, and service events in Bloomington.
headline: What members do
intro: Net Impact IU members can join a consulting project team, build career skills at weekly meetings, and give back through service events. Most members do all three.

programs.title: Nonprofit consulting project teams
programs.status: Applications open at the start of each semester.
programs.text: Students provide free consulting to local nonprofits and get hands-on experience. Each team has one project lead and five consultants, meets with its client weekly or biweekly, and delivers results by the end of the semester.
bullets: Apply and interview at the start of the semester (about two weeks)
Rank the projects you want to work on
Send weekly updates to the Net Impact consulting team
Clients give mid-semester and end-of-semester feedback

programs.title: Professional development
programs.status: General meetings every Monday, 7:00 to 8:00 pm.
programs.text: Hands-on general meetings help members explore careers in sustainability, corporate responsibility and social impact, and build the skills employers in those fields look for.
bullets: Topics and rooms posted each week on Instagram

programs.title: Service and community
programs.text: Members volunteer together and build friendships through socials and campus events.
bullets: Volunteer events at organizations like Hoosier Hills Food Bank
Socials, from bowling to tote bag painting
Campus events like the Kelley Carnival
